contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ FL IVL HE [---] ; R/ [PAX] PV BLICA

Copper alloy Coin. Commemorative Nummus for Helena (324-341), posthumous Pax Publica issue of 337-340, Reece period 17. Obverse description; Female bust veiled and draped right. Obverse inscription: FL IVL HE [---]. Reverse description: Pax standing left with transverse sceptre. Reverse inscription: [PAX] PV BLICA. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 14.5mm, Weight: 1.82gms, die axis: 12
